capabilities: Assign a knowledge base to each vault folder
Preview planned uploads, updates and deletions
Sync manually, on vault changes, or on an interval
Filter files by note properties and attachment extensions
Show a per-file sync status button in the note header
disambiguation: One-way upload to Langdock knowledge bases, not a two-way vault sync.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.12.4 or later. Images such as JPG, PNG and SVG are skipped because the Knowledge Folder API rejects image uploads; they must be uploaded manually in Langdock. Full documentation, network-use notes and troubleshooting live on an external site.
problem: Copies of notes and attachments in a Langdock knowledge base go stale because they must be uploaded and updated by hand as the vault changes.

requires.name: Langdock workspace API key with KNOWLEDGE_FOLDER_API permission

summary: Syncs selected Markdown notes and attachments from vault folders to assigned Langdock knowledge bases, manually or on a schedule.
